gitCommit.subject: release: UXor 0.2.0 (#123)
gitCommit.body:
release: UXor 0.2.0 (#123)

## What

Release **UXor 0.2.0**: `dev` into `main`. On merge, `release.yml`
checks the install from GitHub, tags `0.2.0` on the merge commit,
publishes the 0.2.0 GitHub Release (marked Latest) from its
`CHANGELOG.md` section, publishes the missing 0.1.0 Release (not
Latest), and deploys the gallery to GitHub Pages.

**Breaking:** the kit is renamed **UXor** and moved to
<https://github.com/xormania/uxor> (formerly `flowbite-xor`). Install
commands use the new URL. An install without a version installs `main`.

### Added
- Recipes: `data-table`, `data-table-live`, `autocomplete`, `popover`,
`calendar`, `date-picker`, `dropzone`, `chart`, `editor`,
`markdown-editor`, `side-nav`, `mobile-nav`, `nav-menu`, `section-nav`.
- Shared modules: `floating` (positioning), `turbo` (Turbo cached-page
checks), `navigation`.
- `theme`: chart series roles and on-fill text roles.
- A gallery of every recipe and README example in light and dark, with
code and install commands, published on GitHub Pages; `FOR-AGENTS.md`,
`llms.txt` and `SECURITY.md`.

### Changed
- Motion: named transition properties; `prefers-reduced-motion` is
respected.
- `tabs` keyboard support follows WAI-ARIA; `layouts` keeps form state
across Back and Forward; mobile navigation, `navbar_nav`, and `settings`
with `section-nav`.
- `form-theme`: `EditorType`, `MarkdownType`, and date picker and
Dropzone opt-ins.
- Documentation no longer tracks the official `flowbite-4` kit; the
README is shorter.

### Fixed
- Native controls follow the page theme rather than the operating
system's (`color-scheme`) (#121).
- `Input` without a `type` had no padding; `Select` text ran under its
chevron in both directions; a multiple `Select` showed a chevron (#121).
- `button`: the keyboard focus outline reaches 3:1 or more on every
variant in both themes, from 1.1–1.8:1 (#122).
- `modal`: the backdrop fades and never blocks closing (#111); WebKit
toast (#110); overlays after Back and Live re-renders.
- `floating`: popovers, menus and tooltips fall back below or above
their trigger and stay within the viewport on phones; tooltips are
placed inside a bordered wrapper (#125).
- `pagination`: the current page reaches 4.5:1 or more in the dark
theme, from 2.7:1; stat card values fit at tablet widths; the navbar
fits at 320px; data tables and README examples fit at phone width
(#126).
- Gallery: phone overflow, wide-screen hero, branch-aware banner and
install commands (#120); Markdown rendering, long names, header on
phones, favicon, sidebar position (#122).

### Security (external audit of `87b9cfb`)
- URL props are guarded on `Button`, `Badge`, `Dropdown:Item`,
`Pagination:Link` and `Avatar:Image` (#119).
- Every component drops `on…` attributes and checks `href`, `formaction`
and `src` regardless of case; `srcset` and `ping` are never rendered
(#119).
- Demo: production boot is refused unless explicitly enabled with a
strong secret; the production image build is fixed (#115).
- Repository trust policy for workflows and CI (#117).

### Release and CI
- `release.yml` checks the install of the newest version only and
publishes an older version's missing Release without blocking Pages
(#118).
- Pages preview from `dev` (#114); CI images pinned by digest (#113);
duration-based test shards (#112); advisory failure diagnosis on failing
jobs (#100); shared test helpers (#116).
- The monthly coverage run excludes `@release` specs; failed jobs end
their log with the test results and keep the full server log as an
artifact (#127).

## Why

0.2.0 is the first release since 0.1.0 (2026-10-06). It adds fourteen
recipes, renames the kit to UXor, and includes the fixes from an
external security audit and a UX and visual review of the gallery.

## Coverage map

Each pull request merged into `dev` for this release carries its own
coverage map. This pull request adds no code. Release-level checks:

| Guarantee | Scope | Coverage |
|---|---|---|
| The released kit installs from GitHub in a fresh Symfony app | release
| `release.yml` install check, before the tag |
| The release job tags 0.2.0, publishes 0.1.0's Release, and never skips
Pages for an older version | static |
`tools/tests/release-workflow.test.mjs`, `tools/tests/release-plan.sh`
(#118) |
| Long sessions, fuzzing and timings | release checks |
`release-checks.yml` |
| Coverage, mutation testing, cross-engine screenshots, interaction
timings | monthly | `monthly.yml` |

## Verification

All on the release commit `504b720` unless noted.

- **CI:** passed, every job
([run](https://github.com/xormania/uxor/actions/runs/38188969128)).
Lint, contrast, kit PHP, importmap packages, static site, fresh installs
(local and Symfony Docker from GitHub), and the Playwright suite in
Chromium, Firefox and WebKit (10 shards).
- **Release checks:** passed on the second attempt; the Release suite's
tests took 17 minutes
([run](https://github.com/xormania/uxor/actions/runs/38188972446)). The
first attempt failed on one test; see *Known limitations*.
- **Monthly:** passed, every job, 17 minutes
([run](https://github.com/xormania/uxor/actions/runs/38193724501)). PHP
line coverage and Infection mutation score; JS coverage of the Stimulus
controllers; Firefox and WebKit screenshots against the Chromium
baselines (report only); interaction timings.
- **CodeQL and dependency audits (npm, Composer):** passed
([CodeQL](https://github.com/xormania/uxor/actions/runs/38188972526),
[audits](https://github.com/xormania/uxor/actions/runs/38188972435)).
- **Release plan dry run** on a local merge of `dev` into `main`
(`tools/release-plan.sh --dry-run`): 0.2.0 is tagged on the merge commit
with the full 0.2.0 section as release notes; the existing 0.1.0 tag is
correct and receives its Release only.

## Known limitations

- Components URL-check `href`, `formaction` and `src` only; other URL
attributes (`action`, `data`, `poster`…) render as given, and
`docs/GUIDE.md` asks apps to check them. Importmap integrity hashes are
not yet in place.
- Disabled text measures 1.9–2.7:1 (exempt under WCAG); the empty toast
region starts 10px off-screen on `/demo` at 390px.
- A Firefox test (`demo-app.spec.ts`, mobile drawer) fails
intermittently in local runs; it has not failed in CI, which retries
once.
- The release check `release.long-session.spec.ts` intermittently times
out waiting for its first page to load (the first Release checks attempt
on `504b720`, and the first monthly run); it passed on the second
attempt and did not reproduce locally. It is tracked for a fix after
this release.
- After the release, `main` is merged back into `dev`
(`CONTRIBUTING.md`, *Releases*).

## Checks

- CI on the last commit (`504b720`): passed, every job; Release checks
and Monthly passed.
- Verified by hand: release plan dry run (above).
- `CHANGELOG.md` entry: `## [0.2.0] - 2026-10-11`
